resources.string: The day\'s lines from Recollect: what today holds, the focus, what\'s next.
Recollect\'s picture of your day, on this phone.
On your computer, open Recollect → Settings → Phone app and make the connect code. Point this phone\'s camera at it, open the link, then tap Open the phone app.
There\'s no connect link on the clipboard. Copy it in Settings → Phone app first.
The code lets this app read only the picture of your day and its lines.
This phone will show the picture of your day from %1$s.
Keep a copy of my wallpaper to put back if I disconnect
Android asks once to let the app read your current wallpaper.
Connected. Your lock screen shows the day.
This link isn\'t a Recollect connect link. Make a new code in Settings → Phone app.
For an address on the internet, Recollect needs https. Check the address in Settings → Phone app.
Couldn\'t reach Recollect at %1$s. Until Recollect is online, the phone needs your computer on and the same Wi-Fi or hotspot, or the USB cable.
This phone\'s code was ended. Make a new one on your computer in Settings → Phone app.
This code can\'t read the picture. Make a new one in Settings → Phone app.
Recollect answered with an error (%1$d). The app tries again in half an hour.
Recollect sent something this app can\'t read. Build and install the latest app.
The phone didn\'t accept the wallpaper. Try Refresh now.
Quiet hours: the wallpaper changes again at %1$s.
The widget can show the same lines on the home screen: touch and hold an empty spot, tap Widgets, then Recollect.
The home screen can also show the same lines as a widget.
The home screen keeps the last picture. Pick another wallpaper in the phone\'s settings.
The lock screen keeps the last picture. Pick another wallpaper in the phone\'s settings.
The home screen shows the phone\'s own wallpaper again.
The lock screen shows your home wallpaper again.
For the wallpaper and the widget. System follows the phone\'s dark mode.
No wallpaper changes or notifications between these times.
Counts instead of topic and focus names, for a lock screen anyone can see.
Recollect\'s web address isn\'t known yet.
The app stops changing the wallpaper, ends its code and puts your old wallpaper back.
The app stops changing the wallpaper and ends its code. The lock screen shows your home wallpaper again.
If the lock screen shows other pictures, turn off Glance: Settings → Home screen, Lock screen & Always-On Display → Glance for realme → Activate on Lockscreen.
For the picture to change on its own, let this app run in the background: App info → Battery usage → Allow background activity, and Allow auto-launch.
It writes its first lines after it thinks tonight.
Nothing more to say for now.
Got it. It thinks about it tonight.
Your buddy is paused. Turn it on again in Recollect → About you.
Tell me when it leaves a note
At most two a day, never in quiet hours. A note that touches something private shows only as \"a new note\" on the lock screen.
Notifications are off for this app. Turn them on in App info.
Your buddy left you a note. Open the app to read it.
When your buddy leaves you a new note: at most two a day, never in quiet hours.
Open the app to connect this phone.
